about: Own-words reads from the daily research task (ADMIS, Rabobank, Czapp and the news feed). fund_score: -1 bearish to +1 bullish, a judgement on the fundamental news only.

corn.fundamental: Dec fell ~2% to ~437.5, through 443.5 and 440.75 supports, dragged by wheat and crude; no new supply news beyond a near-finished US harvest.
events: Wheat and crude selloff spill over (Reuters)

soybeans.fundamental: Jan eased ~1% to ~1,214.5 with soyoil weakness; record crush demand intact, China buying pace still the swing factor.
events: Market still waiting on follow-through China purchases (Grainews)

meal.fundamental: Meal held up (Dec ~335.9, +0.7) while soyoil fell 3%, so the crush value keeps rotating toward meal.
events: ADMIS: soymeal the outlier in a lower trade (ADMIS)

oil.fundamental: Soyoil Dec dropped ~3.3% to ~60.1, through 61.34 and 60.54 supports, as crude slid again; the move is energy-led, with no change in biofuel policy.
events: Crude down ~4% on US stock builds (Reuters)

wheat.fundamental: Dec SRW down ~3.6% to ~574, through 582.5/581.25 supports, as the Black Sea risk premium keeps bleeding out on truce hopes; US winter wheat conditions remain comfortable.
events: Black Sea truce hopes erase strike premium (Investing.com, UkrAgroConsult)

kc.fundamental: HRW Dec down ~2.9% to ~614.5, under the 626/625.5 supports, following Chicago lower on the faded Black Sea premium.

cotton.fundamental: Dec slid to ~75.8 (-1.5) through both 77.05 and 76.47 supports in first-notice week, with Mar ~79.9 also lower; no new US or Brazil supply news, so this is old-crop Dec/Mar liquidation and certificate flow at work — high-grade certs available for delivery are not a comfort for longs.
events: Dec ~75.83 (-1.49), low 75.58, below 76.47 support (ICE via TradingView)
Wider commodity selloff led by crude and wheat (Reuters)

hogs.fundamental: Dec made another 52-week low (51.2) and sits ~51.8; ample hog supply and weak cash keep the pressure on.

cattle.fundamental: Feedlot losses above $500/head against rebounding packer margins and Tyson's added Texas capacity point to firmer packer demand; screwworm spreading in the Southwest is the supply wild card. Cattle on Feed due Friday.
events: Feedlot losses top $500/head as packer margins rebound (Drovers)
Tyson adds Texas beef capacity via Allied Beef deal (Farm Progress)
New World screwworm spreading across southwestern states (Successful Farming)

feeders.fundamental: Screwworm spread keeps feeder supply tight, but heavy feedlot losses cap what feeders can pay; Jan slipped overnight.
events: Screwworm spreading across southwestern states (Successful Farming)

class3.fundamental: HPAI has returned to an Oklahoma dairy herd for the first time in over two years, a milk-supply risk if it spreads; otherwise the herd-expansion story still dominates.
events: HPAI detected in Oklahoma dairy herd (Dairy Herd, Successful Farming)
CME spot mixed; butter and NFDM firmer (Brownfield)
Debate over whether herd expansion continues (Brownfield)

class4.fundamental: Firmer spot butter and NFDM Tuesday plus the HPAI return in Oklahoma lend modest support to Class IV components.
events: CME spot butter and NFDM higher Tuesday (Brownfield)
HPAI detected in Oklahoma dairy herd (Dairy Herd)

palm.fundamental: Malaysian Jan eased ~0.7% to ~4,272 with soyoil and crude; nothing new on Malaysian output or exports.

natgas.fundamental: Dec gas bucked the energy selloff, up ~4% to ~3.34 toward the 3.397 resistance on colder late-November forecasts and steady LNG feedgas; storage report Thursday.

crude.fundamental: WTI Dec fell ~3.8% to ~82.7, through the 83.88 support, as US inventory builds and the surplus outlook outweigh Hormuz/Iran shipping risk; next support is far lower around 77.
events: US crude stock builds temper supply-risk premium (Reuters)

ulsd.fundamental: ULSD Dec slipped ~2.3% to ~3.95, below 3.9947 support; Russian refinery strikes still support cracks but crude's slide dominates.

rbob.fundamental: Gasoline Dec down ~2.9% to ~2.46 with crude, holding above 2.42 support; seasonal demand lull and stock builds keep it heavy.
